sources.title: Ninja Manual
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: CMake：目標介面與隔離建置目錄
related.titleEn: CMake: target interfaces and isolated build trees
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付ninja-edges.csv、dirty原因與command變更回歸測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver ninja-edges.csv, dirty reasons and command-change regression evidence.
related.difference: 建立core、ui、app三target，列出每個的自用與傳遞include需求；用target命令而非全域旗標。
related.differenceEn: Definecore, ui, app and tabulate private versus propagated include requirements using target commands.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
Ninja執行明確建置圖，depfile或dyndep補足發現的相依；dirty狀態必須沿受影響edge傳播。
教學基準：4+1 = 5 edges；對照：5-1 = 4 edges。

target的PRIVATE/PUBLIC/INTERFACE規範使用需求傳播；不同組態需要獨立cache而非混用來源樹產物。
教學基準：2+0 = 2 inherited_paths；對照：2+1 = 3 inherited_paths。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Ninja executes an explicit graph; depfiles or dyndep supply discovered dependencies and dirty state propagates through affected edges.
Teaching baseline: 4+1 = 5 edges; comparison: 5-1 = 4 edges.

PRIVATE, PUBLIC and INTERFACE specify usage-requirement propagation; configurations need appropriate separate caches rather than mixed source-tree artifacts.
Teaching baseline: 2+0 = 2 inherited_paths; comparison: 2+1 = 3 inherited_paths.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: PIT：變異測試分母與等價變異
related.titleEn: PIT: mutation-score denominators and equivalent mutants
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付ninja-edges.csv、dirty原因與command變更回歸測試。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver ninja-edges.csv, dirty reasons and command-change regression evidence.
related.difference: 分別保存原始可執行分母18及經證據排除等價後分母16；禁止把未分析的存活直接移出分母。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Retain executable denominator18 and evidence-adjusted denominator16 separately; never exclude unexplained survivors. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
Ninja執行明確建置圖，depfile或dyndep補足發現的相依；dirty狀態必須沿受影響edge傳播。
教學基準：4+1 = 5 edges；對照：5-1 = 4 edges。

基準 14/(20-2)*100 = 77.77777777777777 percent；對照 14/(20-2-2)*100 = 87.5 percent。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
分別保存原始可執行分母18及經證據排除等價後分母16；禁止把未分析的存活直接移出分母。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Ninja executes an explicit graph; depfiles or dyndep supply discovered dependencies and dirty state propagates through affected edges.
Teaching baseline: 4+1 = 5 edges; comparison: 5-1 = 4 edges.

Baseline 14/(20-2)*100 = 77.77777777777777 percent; comparison 14/(20-2-2)*100 = 87.5 percent. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Retain executable denominator18 and evidence-adjusted denominator16 separately; never exclude unexplained survivors.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
